I'm designing a motion/"juice" system (animations, shader accents, interaction variants) for Twyne, a Qwik + Convex local-first writing app at /home/diogenes/Projects/apps/twyne. Brand: editorial, letterpress, literary writer's room (paper, ink, stamps, vermilion/cobalt). I need a precise inventory of the **editor chrome** (everything around the manuscript, not the text surface itself) so I can give every component a purposeful interaction. Do not edit anything.

Scope:
- `src/routes/editor/index.tsx` (1900 lines): the left Drawer (folio list, new folio, shared drawer), masthead/top bar, sidebar toggles, sign-in toast, workspace error notice, zen-mode toggling, right panel docking/resizing, the hydration gate ("Press Room / Setting the type…").
- `src/components/folio/folio-menu*`, `src/components/auth/account-menu*`, `src/components/collaboration/share-dialog*`, `src/components/editor/sync-indicator.tsx`, `src/components/editor/compositor-panel.tsx`, `src/components/editor/page-ruler.tsx`, `src/components/editor/page-chrome.tsx`, `src/components/editor/page-border.tsx`, `src/components/editor/typst-workspace.tsx` (+ .css), `src/components/editor/typst-source-ribbon.tsx`, `src/components/revisions/version-history-panel*`, `src/components/writing-tools/live-review-status*`, `src/components/writing-tools/writing-tools-panel*`, `src/components/editor/shortcut-dialog.tsx`, `src/components/brief/project-brief-card*`.
- Find the global.css rules for the classes they use (src/global.css is 10k lines — grep class names, don't read it whole), e.g. `.sidebar-transition`, `.btn-press`, `.btn-paper`, `.folio`, `.dept-label`, `.dossier-action-pending`, `.editor-workspace-shell`. Note: `.icon-btn` and `.dept-label` are each defined twice — report both. Flow/zen rules live around global.css lines 8600-8660 and 10000-10075.

For EACH visible component/sub-element report, compactly:
1. file:line of its root JSX and what it shows.
2. Every user interaction (hover, click, keyboard shortcut, drag/resize, toggle) and what it does.
3. Current feedback/motion: transitions, keyframes, hover/focus/active styles, busy/disabled/error/success variants (class names + global.css line numbers).
4. The *consequence class* of each action: local-only, syncs to account (Convex), sends text to an AI provider / spends hosted credits, publishes or shares publicly, destructive/irreversible, or view-only.
5. State that changes over time (save/sync status, word counts, review status) that could animate.
6. Inconsistencies (different button styles, radii, shadows, fonts across these pieces).

Also: how zen mode works (what toggles, which classes), how panels open/close (classes, widths), and any "quiet while typing" mechanism (e.g. `data-flow="flow"|"settling"` — find where it's set and what it means).

Return a structured list (one block per component), terse, file:line references. Under ~1500 words.

Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 1800000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.

# Twyne editor chrome inventory (read-only)

All paths are under `/home/diogenes/Projects/apps/twyne/`. `g:` means `src/global.css`, `tw:` means `src/components/editor/typst-workspace.css`, and `idx:` means `src/routes/editor/index.tsx`.

**Consequence codes:** L = local only (IndexedDB/localStorage). S = syncs to Convex (`markDirty`). AI = sends text to a model provider. P = publishes or shares. D = destructive. V = view only.

## Shared primitives (global.css)
- **`.btn-press`** g:2069-2099: ink fill, typewriter caps, radius 2px, 0.12s transform. Hover turns vermilion-2 with a glow shadow. Active is `translateY(1px) scale(.98)`. Disabled is opacity .4. Focus at g:2156.
- **`.btn-paper`** g:2101-2125: sans 600, radius 2px. Hover goes to paper-2 with a shade shadow. Active is `translateY(1px)`.
- **`.icon-btn`** has two definitions:
  - g:2164-2188: 1.75rem hit target, hover background paper-2, active `scale(.9)`, focus offset 1px.
  - g:4496-4503: redefines the transition (transform + color only, so the background transition is lost) and sets active to `scale(.92)`. The second one wins.
- **`.dept-label`** has two definitions:
  - g:582: typewriter, 0.625rem, letter-spacing .32em, ink-muted.
  - g:4488-4493: adds a letter-spacing transition, and hover sets .22em. So every kicker *tightens* on hover, which is odd for non-interactive labels.
- **`.tool-btn`** g:2191-2217: hover vermilion, active `scale(.95)`. Pressed state (`[aria-pressed=true]`) gets an inset vermilion underline.
- **Other primitives:**
  - `.focus-ring` g:1768: 2px vermilion outline, offset 2px.
  - Global rule `button, a { transition: color/bg/border .15s }` at g:4506.
  - `.folio` g:699 (embossed sheet), `.index-card` g:622, `.ornament-divider` g:590, `.stamp` g:607 (rotated -3deg), `.field-live` g:7152.
- **Existing keyframes worth reusing:**
  - `stamp-die-press` g:1939, `stamp-ink-settle` g:1970, `presswobble` g:2034 (`.press`, infinite).
  - `ink-bleed` g:4268, `dossier-action-pulse` g:2144, `filed-dossier-arrive` g:687.
  - `application-toast-in` g:4549, `gentle-pulse` g:4560.
- **Reduced motion:** g:4091, g:4582, g:10003.

## Hydration gate ("Press Room")
1. idx:1110-1124: `.folio` card containing "Press Room" (`.dept-label`) and italic display text "Setting the type…".
2. No interactions.
3. No motion; it swaps hard to the workspace.
4. V.
5. Driven by `store.hydrated`. A natural spot for a type-setting or ink-down reveal.

## Sign-in toast
1. idx:1129-1178: fixed bottom-center, `border-2` ink, **radius 4px**, heavy shadow `0 14px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.28)` (hard-coded rgba, not `--shade`), ❦ fleuron.
2. Interactions:
   - "Sign in" (`.btn-press`): opens AccountMenu and saves a dismissed flag to IndexedDB.
   - "Not now" (typewriter text link): dismisses.
3. No enter or exit animation. It does not use `.application-toast` (`application-toast-in`).
4. L (dismissal). Sign-in leads to S.

## Workspace error notice
1. idx:1751-1771: `ApplicationNotice` (`src/components/ui/application-notice.tsx:79`) in a bordered strip.
2. Interactions: Dismiss, plus a recovery link ("Sign in" → /signin/).
3. No motion.
4. V/L.
5. Shown when `workspaceError` or `joinError` is set.

## The Drawer (left sidebar)
1. idx:1181-1517: `<aside class="sidebar-transition …">`, `w-72` (288px) when open, `w-0` when closed, with a fixed-width `w-72` inner box.
2. Elements and interactions:
   - **Header** idx:1187-1232: "Drawer No. {numeral}" / "Shared drawer", a display h2 title, and a `role=status` line with folio count and access role (eye / edit / comment-add icons).
   - **Folio rows** idx:1239-1256: click calls `activateFolio`, which stops research and the room, loads from IndexedDB, and remounts the editor via `folioKey`. Active row: paper-3 border on paper-soft. Inactive: transparent border with hover paper-soft. Radius 2px, serif. **No transition on active-row change, and no focus-ring style beyond `.focus-ring`.** Consequence L (saves active id); it restarts AI background processes.
   - **New folio** idx:1300-1310: dashed button opens an inline input (idx:1261, autoFocus, vermilion focus border). Enter / "Create" (`.btn-press`) calls `createFolio`, which persists, runs `markDirty` (S) and navigates to /dossier/create. Escape / "Cancel" (`.btn-paper`) closes.
   - **ProjectBriefCard** idx:1322 (see below).
   - **Nav links** idx:1342-1426: Room of Editors, Library, Galley Proof, Full Analysis, Apparatus, Subscription, My Desk, Composing Room. All share the same hover background. "Tools" (idx:1378) is a button that opens the Board's tools tab (V).
   - **"Elsewhere in the paper"** idx:1438-1455, then Terms/Privacy at idx:1457.
   - **"+ File a new piece"** idx:1506 (`.btn-press w-full`): opens a confirm `.index-card` (idx:1478), then `createFolio(Untitled)` (S). The state is still named `confirmNukeOpen` but nothing is destroyed.
3. Motion: `.sidebar-transition` g:1761 animates width/opacity/transform over 0.2s ease (reduced motion at g:4103). Only width actually changes. Content is clipped, not faded.
4. Hidden in flow (g:8641).
5. Folio count, role, active row, and `newFolioFormOpen` change over time.

## Masthead
1. idx:1522-1749: `<header hidden={zenActive}>` with a double border-bottom.
2. Contents and interactions:
   - **Drawer toggle** idx:1527 (`.icon-btn`, hover vermilion, hamburger SVG): flips `leftSidebarOpen` and clamps `rightPanelWidth`. The icon does not change state (no `aria-expanded` visual). V.
   - **Wordmark area** idx:1553-1570, an `@container`: kicker "An Anti-Tabula-Rasa Quarterly" (hidden under 16.5rem), "TWYNE" with `.masthead-wordmark.press.ink-bleed`, and a dateline (hidden under 18.25rem).
     - `.press` is an infinite 4s wobble (g:2046).
     - `.ink-bleed` hover runs keyframe g:4480.
     - Sizes step down via container queries (g:2054-2066).
     - Links to "/".
   - **Dossier button** idx:1575-1592 (`.btn-paper`): navigates to create/refine dossier. With no brief it adds `.dossier-action-pending` (g:2127-2154): a vermilion border plus a `::after` 2.8s pulse ring with **radius 4px**. The label shows only at ≥1280px.
   - **FolioMenu**, **ShareDialog** (only when authenticated), **AccountMenu**, then the **Board toggle** idx:1718 (`.icon-btn`): toggles `rightPanelOpen`.
   - **Rule** idx:1744: hairlines with a vermilion ✦.
3. In zen the `.zen-masthead` class is added (g:4516-4529: max-height 24px, opacity 0, hover reveal). **This is dead code.** The `hidden` attribute plus `.zen-masthead[hidden]{display:none}` (g:10067) means there is no hover strip.
4. Flow: settling sets opacity .4 (1.2s), and hover brings it back to 1 (0.2s) (g:8611, 8648). Flow sets it to hidden over 1.2s while keeping its size (g:8637).

## FolioMenu (`src/components/folio/folio-menu.tsx`)
1. Trigger at :670: `.btn-paper text-xs` reading "File ▾". Dropdown at :684: `.folio w-56` with `role=menu`. Closes on outside click or Escape (:155-169).
2. Items:
   - "Dossier & House context" link: V.
   - "Include persona comments" checkbox: L.
   - `MenuItem` (:1293, serif, **radius 0**, hover paper-soft) entries:
     - "PDF…"
     - "PDF (Typst)…" (busy label "Preparing Typst export…", and a "Cancel Typst export" item while busy)
     - ".typ", Markdown, HTML, DOCX, Plain text, Twyne backup
     - All of these are local downloads (L).
   - "Import…" opens a modal (:829, `rgba(15,12,8,.55)` scrim, `.folio` 28rem) with a dashed drop label reading "click to choose a file" / "reading…". It writes to IndexedDB, may create a new folio, then `onImported$` remounts the editor and runs `markDirty`. S, and it **replaces the current manuscript in view**.
   - Typst status popover at :808: `role=alert` or `status`, "Cancel export" / "Dismiss".
   - **Share modal** :907:
     - "Publish now" (`.btn-press`, busy "Publishing…"): `api.published.publish`. **P**.
     - "Copy" link (shows "Copied"), "Open the public view ↗".
     - "Unpublish" (busy "…"): **P + D**, with no confirmation.
     - "Download page for my domain": L.
     - PDS: Connect / Publish / Re-publish / "Unpublish from PDS" (busy "Updating…" / "Removing…"). **P**, unpublish is D.
     - Micropub "Publish via Micropub". **P**.
3. Feedback is text swaps only, with no motion. Copy uses `copyState` "idle" → "copied". The dropdown and modals appear with no transition. Notices use `ApplicationNotice compact`.

## ShareDialog (`src/components/collaboration/share-dialog.tsx`)
1. Trigger at :342: `.btn-paper` "Share" with an inline SVG. Presence avatars at :370: 24px colored circles, maximum 4 plus "+N", **polled every 4s** (:163). Popover at :408: `.folio w-80`, with a transparent click-catcher at :399.
2. Actions:
   - "Share this folio" (`.btn-press`, "Promoting…"): **P/S, Pro feature**.
   - Invite email + role select + "Invite" ("Inviting…"): P.
   - Collaborator "remove" (tiny typewriter text, hover vermilion): **D**, no confirm.
   - "View recovery copies" link.
   - "Copy invite link" (`.btn-paper`): message "Invite link copied."
   - "Stop sharing" (vermilion text) opens `ThemedDialog tone="danger"` (:591): **D**.
3. No motion on presence join/leave or on the popover.
5. Presence count and the collaborator list change over time and could animate.

## AccountMenu (`src/components/auth/account-menu.tsx`)
1. Trigger at :174, `.icon-btn`:
   - Signed in: **sage border**, avatar or initials circle, name shown at ≥lg.
   - Signed out: user icon.
   - Dropdown at :225: `.folio w-72 p-3`.
2. Contents and interactions:
   - Alias link.
   - Nav buttons (:238-305): display font, hover turns the **text** vermilion (no background, unlike the drawer and FolioMenu, which use background hover). Covers Desk, Account, Preferences, Plans (behind a flag), Manual, Privacy ledger.
   - Pending invitations (:308): "Open" leads to a shared join (S); "Decline" calls `rejectInvitation` (D, `disabled:opacity-50` while busy).
   - Shared-with-me list (:362).
   - `AuthPanel` sign-in (S).
   - Outside click or Escape closes (:151-170).
   - Opened externally by the toast or `?shared=` via the `accountOpen` signal.
3. No open/close motion.
6. Section headings here use a sans, 10px, .12em tracking label instead of `.dept-label`.

## Editorial Board (right panel)
1. `src/components/editorial-board/editorial-board-overlay.tsx:73`, mounted at idx:1817.
2. Interactions:
   - Close "×" (:106), or Escape while focus is inside the board (:83-102). Focus returns to the toggle.
   - Context tabs (:126): personas, rubric, comments, citations, tools, history. Each has a numeral and a per-tab `--context-accent`. Unread badges show 9+.
   - In citations: "Steer search" composer (busy, error, notice states). **AI** (`steerBackgroundResearch`).
3. CSS:
   - g:4752: width `min(29rem,100%-3rem)`; apparatus variant 31rem (g:4777).
   - Closed (`--closed`, g:4780): width 0, hidden, opacity 0.
   - Transition is 180ms `cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)` on opacity/width/transform. Backdrop blur(12px). Shadow `rgba(32,25,16,.12)`, hard-coded.
   - Active tab (g:4943): accent bottom border plus a 7% accent tint, with **no transition**.
   - Badge (g:4928): a pill (radius 999px), **white** text.
   - Mobile at g:5116; reduced motion at g:5137.
   - Panels stay mounted and are hidden with the `hidden` class (idx:1839-1904).
5. Unread counts arrive via the `twyne:panel-activity` event.
- **No drag-resize exists.** `store.rightPanelWidth` (idx:248, 677, 1530) is clamped but never rendered. It is dead state.

## LiveReviewStatus (`src/components/writing-tools/live-review-status.tsx`)
1. :136 notice row (`--notice`) or :174 finding line, styled at g:7230-7280. It is not rendered in zen (idx:1774).
2. Interactions:
   - "◇ finding" toggles the detail (V).
   - "Sign in" / "Set up a model" links.
   - "×" dismiss (stored in sessionStorage, L).

2. Elements and interactions:
   - **Desk controls row** :246 (`.editor-desk-controls`, tw:358):

     - View tabs Write / Source / Proof (`.compositor-tab.typst-view`, pressed state vermilion, tw:37).
     - "Split" toggle.
     - "PDF" / "Previous PDF" download (L).

   - **Status bar** :555 (`.typst-statusbar.editor-bottom-bar`, tw:250/458):

## "Quiet while typing" (flow)
- **Where it is set:** `src/components/editor/extensions/flow-conductor.ts:500-505` sets `document.documentElement.dataset.flow`.
- **Modes** come from `src/utils/flow-state.ts`: away | working | settling | flow | stuck.
  - settling: a steady run of ≥30s with gaps ≤4s.
  - flow: ≥90s.
- **AI gate:** entering flow is **confirmed by Jev**. It sends the last 1500 characters of the passage (`flow-conductor.ts:676-689`), so this is **AI**. If declined, the mode stays at settling for 3 minutes.
- **Exit:** Escape, or pointer dwell on the chrome or the top 48px (`flow-conductor.ts:723-745`).
- **CSS:**
  - settling: header, toolbar and rails go to opacity .4 over 1.2s; hover brings them back over 0.2s (g:8611-8651).
  - flow: margin cards hide over 0.8s; header, toolbar, desk controls, live-review and drawer hide over 1.2s, keeping their size.
  - stuck: cards replay `flow-slip-in`.
  - Reduced motion: g:10003-10024.
- Flow also dispatches `twyne:zen-mode {source:"flow"}`, which the route and editor deliberately ignore.
- Other readers: `src/components/living-desk/document-spine.tsx:66`, `src/components/in-flow/flow-surface.tsx:676`, `src/components/editor/forecast-line.tsx:155`.

## Inconsistencies
- **Radii:** 2px almost everywhere. The toast and the `.dossier-action-pending` ring use 4px. MenuItem uses 0. The invitation cards use `rounded-sm`. Avatars and badges are circles.
- **Shadows:** `--shade` color-mix in the buttons, `.folio` and `.index-card`. Hard-coded rgba in the toast, the board, and typst `#0002`. `.filed-dossier-paper` uses an offset hard shadow.
- **Hover idioms:** background paper-soft (drawer, FolioMenu), text vermilion only (AccountMenu, `.icon-btn` triggers), background paper-2 (`.icon-btn` base).
- **Disabled styles:** opacity .4 (`.btn-press`, typst), .3 (compositor undo/redo), .5 (invites), and none at all for `.typst-apply`.
- **Fonts:** item fonts vary. Drawer links use display, folio rows serif, MenuItem serif, AccountMenu display, `.btn-paper` sans, `.btn-press` typewriter.
  - Section labels come in three forms: `.dept-label` (.32em), sans 10px .12em (AccountMenu), and 10px .1em (history).
- **Scrims:** .55 vs .58 alpha. ShareDialog is a popover with a transparent catcher, while FolioMenu "Share…" is a modal.
- **Two "Share" entry points** (FolioMenu publishes publicly; ShareDialog shares with collaborators) look identical (`.btn-paper`) side by side.
- **Destructive actions without confirm:** Unpublish, Unpublish from PDS, remove collaborator, Discard source. Stop sharing and Restore do have confirms.
- **Dead or ineffective code:**
  - `.zen-masthead` hover reveal.
  - `rightPanelWidth`.
  - The `.icon-btn` second definition drops the background transition.
  - The `.dept-label` hover tightening.
